verdict.one_line_verdict: The most trustworthy guardrails I saw, with a real open API, MCP and a commercially sharp readiness view; it buys correctly and safely, but strict-allergen and multi-item requests too often end with nothing the cook can act on.

evidence: Official example ordered automatically: 1,000 l Valio Eila lactose-free semi-skimmed milk, Mon 16 Nov, €1,010.00 excl. VAT, cut-off Sun 17:00, 4-step evidence panel all Done
Scenario B on a mobile viewport: €506.16 went to the Head Chef; I approved on the phone approver page; 're-checked live · Confirmed'; decision log showed 6 entries with 'Hash chain verified ✓'
API: products/search → offers → proposals with the Bearer demo-agent key returned structured JSON with offerHash, validUntil, per-fact source and retrievedAt
Finnish last-minute request on mobile gave a 3-line split order sent to a human without errors
weaknesses: Evidence detail is very dense (dozens of facts per product, codes like CONFLICT · K3), which takes time for a non-technical buyer
Approver role picker is a native select with no password, so it is weak as a demo of identity

evidence: Finnish 'huomiseksi' was resolved to Mon 16 Nov; 'gluteeniton ja maidoton' became gluten-free plus milk-free hard requirements
'raastettua emmentaljuustoa' returned only grated emmental (2.5 mm grated packs)
Contradictory 'milk-free whipping cream made from cows milk' got a precise clarifying question; nothing was ordered
Vague 'cream maybe' asked for a quantity with quick-pick chips
weaknesses: Two-item school request: one item failed, so the whole order was blocked and the fulfillable pasta was not offered for approval
Pasta line text 'Availability was found by the deadline' sits under a 'No order' headline, which reads as contradictory
Closest match for oat drink was a 20 kg sack of oat flour
Split cheese order delivers 201.5 kg against 200 kg asked, with no note

evidence: Mandate shown as three plain lists (alone / needs person / always refused) for each buyer
Approver view states the reason in one sentence ('signs off on €6.16 over the auto-approve limit') with exact lines and VAT
Manipulative text was blocked above the €15,000 hard limit and tagged 'Instruction ignored'
POST /v0.1/proposals/{id}/approve with the agent key returned 404; the hotel key acting for the school returned 403 'This credential belongs to another buyer'
Re-check before confirmation was logged; the single-use approval link showed 'no longer valid' after use; JSON/CSV export available
weaknesses: Role-only approver sign-in (stated as a demo limitation)
Audit verify requires the agent key; I did not check the Valio-side cross-buyer audit view

evidence: 'Butter for today' was blocked with 'Available Mon 16 Nov, after your Sun 15 Nov deadline' and a one-click 'Use Mon 16 Nov'

State is in memory only

Hard limits that held against manipulation, with the ignored instruction made visible
Finnish requests interpreted correctly, including product form (grated) and dates
Detects contradictions and vague requests and asks one precise question instead of guessing
Real open interface: OpenAPI plus MCP, buyer-scoped keys, agent cannot approve
Per-fact source and fetch time, plus a tamper-evident decision log exportable as JSON/CSV
Valio-side readiness view that turns data gaps into a fix list

verdict.one_line_verdict: The most complete trusted-agent gateway I tested: works on a phone, in Finnish and over the API, and hard limits held against manipulation. Its only real gap is blocking a whole order when one line can't be met.

evidence: Official example in UI: AUTO-confirmed 1,000 l lactose-free Eila milk drink, €1,010.00, Mon 16 Nov, evidence and decision log shown
Same flow over raw HTTP (agent/run, products/search, offers, proposals) and MCP initialize/tools/list
Scenario B approved by Head Chef on mobile viewport; live re-check, Confirmed, single-use link invalidated
No crashes on any of my own requests
weaknesses: Several of my own requests (GF+milk-free bread, salmon today) end in NO_CANDIDATE, so fewer completed orders off-script
Approver role picker is a native select that is awkward to operate

evidence: Finnish 'gluteenitonta ja maidotonta leipää huomiseksi' parsed to bread / FREE_FROM_GLUTEN / AVOID_ALLERGEN AM / 16 Nov
Multi-item 'whipping cream + grated emmental for Wednesday 18.11.' gave the correct types and form (grated), with quantities rounded up to whole packs (31.5 l, 26 kg)
Vague 'some cheese for the weekend' returned a clarifying question about quantity
Assumptions shown as editable chips (Milk drinks accepted, Any fat %)
weaknesses: Official example orders a 'milk drink' as 'milk' (assumption visible but debatable)
Delivery earlier than requested is flagged DATE_LATER and sent to a human
Explanation not available in compact responses

evidence: Strict schemas: extra 'decision' field rejected (422); proposal contradicting bound offer rejected (409)
Prompt injection blocked: OVER_HARD_LIMIT + INSTRUCTION_IGNORED; 'approved by CEO' in a proposal also flagged
Approval is not an MCP tool (error -32601); forged token 403; wrong role 403
Cumulative per-delivery-day limit with explicit reason text
Auto-suspension after 3 refusals in 10 minutes, admin resume logged; SHA-256 chain verify returned verified:true, chainLength 40
Mandate changes versioned (v2, then v3 after reset)
weaknesses: Approver role header and admin key are public and need no password; I changed the school hard limit to €100,000 with the public key (acknowledged as a demo gate)
Hash chain is in memory and verified only by the same server, with no external anchoring
Verifying the audit chain requires the admin key; buyer-scoped verification is unclear

evidence: 200 kg macaroni against 19 packs in stock: offer reduced to 19 packs with PARTIAL_AVAILABILITY, sent to a human
K3 conflict detection: cut-off passed while delivery still offered, product excluded
When nothing qualified it listed searched requirements and exclusion reasons (not deliverable, cut-off, not declared free)
Availability ≥999999 labelled DECLARED 'stock not tracked' with the Valio Q&A quoted as method
weaknesses: DATE_LATER mislabels an earlier delivery
Did not see split/top-up order or earliest-date retry live
No substitute proposed for the impossible-today salmon or the contradictory whipping-cream request, just NO_CANDIDATE

evidence: OpenAPI 3.1 + Swagger /docs, MCP Streamable HTTP with tools/resources/prompts, /spec defining VERIFIED/DECLARED/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN labels, K1–K5 conflicts and reason-code templates
Field-level provenance (system + field + retrievedAt + method) on every fact
Static catalogue shortlist first, then live price/availability for at most ~8–20 candidates: responsible API use
Production gaps stated plainly (SSO/OIDC, scoped credentials, durable storage, real order integration); readiness view quantifies supplier data gaps
weaknesses: Responses are very large and repetitive; compact view not visibly documented
State held in memory only

strengths: Guardrails are enforced server-side with strict schemas, offer-bound proposals and approval tokens tied to one proposal version; prompt injection is detected and logged
Field-level provenance with a published trust-label standard lets an external agent tell verified data from supplier-declared, estimated or unknown data
Agent and human channels separated, also over MCP, with automatic suspension of rogue agents
Honest no-order results instead of invented products; Finnish handled correctly
Valio readiness view turns supplier data quality into a fix list
